_license: Application-authored pose targets; data/LICENSE applies. Reference media are not bundled.
_status: candidate: authored from reference descriptions, not captured motion or signer approval
_frame: +x signer right, +y up, +z forward; targets are WRISTS, not fingertips

hello.variant: Single outward salute, fingertips at the dominant brow

good.variant: ASL-LEX one-handed GOOD: fingertips leave chin and the dominant palm turns up
notes: Chin phase: wrist forward (z 0.34) with fingers tilted back so the fingertips, not the wrist, meet the chin; the previous wrist-at-chest target put the forearm inside the torso.

morning.variant: Two-handed MORNING: small rising motion above a flat horizon hand

my.variant: Flat palm touches the upper chest

name.variant: Index and middle fingers together on both hands, crossing at 80 degrees with two taps
notes: User-requested introduction pose: crossed two-finger hands in front of the chest, with bent elbows.

his.variant: User-requested forward index point with the right elbow open beyond 90 degrees

whats_up.variant: User-requested bent middle fingers toward chest, both hands move forward

im_fine.variant: User-requested index to chest, small forward movement, thumb to chest, index to chest again

thank_you.variant: User-requested chin contact, then straight down with palm kept facing the face and left hand lowered

please.variant: User-requested flat palm parallel to chest, rubbing two small circles

me.variant: Index finger points to the signer’s own chest

help.variant: User-requested thumb-up fist hammers twice onto an outward flat left palm

again.variant: User-requested four fingers rise and tap the centre of the flat left palm twice

understand.variant: User-requested fist beside the right side of the head, palm inward; index rises twice with small nods

two_open.variant: Two-hand coordination warm-up: extend both open palms up and outward

question.variant: User-requested raised index curls twice with a puzzled expression

yes.variant: S-hand nods twice at the wrist; small conversational affirmative

bathroom.variant: Outward-facing T hand shakes side to side twice

where.variant: Index pivots side to side with questioning brows; finger stays straight

good_morning.variant: GOOD followed by the two-handed MORNING variant

her.variant: Same forward index point as HIS, as requested
